facts.fact: The page states that automated birthday emails can generate 481% higher transaction rates than standard promotional sends (vendor's claim, no source or date given).
facts.quote: Automated birthday emails can generate **481% higher transaction rates** and **342% higher revenue per email** than standard promotional sends.

facts.fact: Stripo's 2026 benchmark report recorded an average order value of $744 for birthday automation, nearly 5 times the average across other automations.
facts.quote: A 2026 benchmark report recorded an **average order value of $744** for birthday automation, nearly **5×** the average across other automations.

facts.fact: Omnisend's email marketing statistics report cites a 43.3% open rate for birthday automation.
facts.quote: Omnisend’s email marketing statistics report cites a **43.3% open rate** and a **14.3% click-to-conversion rate** for birthday automation

facts.fact: Square's personalization data indicates personalized emails show 29% higher open rates than non-personalized emails.
